scripts.format-skir:check: cd e2e-test && skir format check && cd ..
scripts.format: prettier --write "**/*.ts" && npm run format-skir && npm run format-python
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "**/*.ts" && npm run format-skir:check && npm run format-python:check
scripts.test: npm run build && cd e2e-test && skir gen && pip install -r requirements.txt && python3 -m unittest tests/**.py && cd ..
scripts.test:local: npm run build && cd e2e-test && skir gen && python3 -m venv test-env && test-env/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && test-env/bin/python3 -m unittest tests/**.py && cd ..
